description: Header file defining classes and methods for reading and parsing JSON representations of IR (Intermediate Representation) data in the header_checker project, including JsonObjectRef, JsonArrayRef, and JsonIRReader.

classes.name: JsonObjectRef
classes.description: A class for accessing values from a read-only JSON object with type checking and default values.

classes.name: JsonArrayRef
classes.description: A template class for iterating over elements of a JSON array as type T.

classes.name: JsonIRReader
classes.description: A class that reads and parses JSON IR data, extending IRReader, with methods to process various IR components.

methods.name: GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the JSON object by key, with type checking.

methods.name: GetInt
methods.description: Retrieves an int64_t value from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: GetUint
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: GetIntegralValue
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON value representing an integral type by key.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JsonObjectRef from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: GetObjects
methods.description: Retrieves an array of JsonObjectRef from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: GetStrings
methods.description: Retrieves an array of strings from the JSON object by key.

methods.name: ReadDumpImpl
methods.description: Implements the logic to read a JSON dump file.

methods.name: ReadFunctions
methods.description: Processes function definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadGlobalVariables
methods.description: Processes global variable definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadEnumTypes
methods.description: Processes enum type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadRecordTypes
methods.description: Processes record (struct/class) type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadFunctionTypes
methods.description: Processes function type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadPointerTypes
methods.description: Processes pointer type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadBuiltinTypes
methods.description: Processes built-in type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadQualifiedTypes
methods.description: Processes qualified type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadArrayTypes
methods.description: Processes array type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadLvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Processes lvalue reference type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadRvalueReferenceTypes
methods.description: Processes rvalue reference type definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadElfFunctions
methods.description: Processes ELF function definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadElfObjects
methods.description: Processes ELF object definitions from a JSON object.

methods.name: ReadTemplateInfo
methods.description: Reads template information from a JSON object into a TemplatedArtifactIR.

methods.name: ReadTypeInfo
methods.description: Reads type information from a JSON object into a TypeIR.

methods.name: ReadRecordFields
methods.description: Reads record fields from a JSON object into a RecordTypeIR.

methods.name: ReadBaseSpecifiers
methods.description: Reads base class specifiers for a record type from JSON.

methods.name: ReadVTableLayout
methods.description: Reads vtable layout information for a record type from JSON.

methods.name: ReadEnumFields
methods.description: Reads enum fields from JSON into an EnumTypeIR.

methods.name: ReadFunctionParametersAndReturnType
methods.description: Reads function parameters and return type from JSON into a CFunctionLikeIR.

methods.name: FunctionJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts a JSON function object into a FunctionIR.

methods.name: FunctionTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts a JSON function type object into a FunctionTypeIR.

methods.name: RecordTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts a JSON record type object into a RecordTypeIR.

methods.name: EnumTypeJsonToIR
methods.description: Converts a JSON enum type object into an EnumTypeIR.
